sheets.prompt: Create a production 2D pixel art character animation SPRITE SHEET of the exact supplied character, preserving outfit, colors and identity. Transparent background. Square canvas 1536x1536 with exactly 6 columns and 6 rows, 36 separate poses in equal 256x256 cells. No text, labels, grid lines, borders, ground shadows, weapons, shields or effects. Each cell has exactly one complete character facing RIGHT in side view; consistent character scale, registration and crisp pixel art. All feet touch the same baseline 32 pixels above the bottom of each cell. Standing character height 195 pixels, all poses centered horizontally, leave generous empty cell margins; do not overlap cells. Row 1 (top): six distinct frames of a looping WALK, alternating legs and arm swing. Row 2: six distinct frames of fast RUN, bent knees, dynamic lean, alternating stride. Row 3: six JUMP phases: takeoff, rising, tucked apex, beginning fall, falling, landing with bent knees. Row 4: six low CROUCH WALK frames, knees deeply bent, head at half standing height, first frame is stationary crouching. Row 5: six PRONE CRAWL frames, horizontal body close to ground, head at RIGHT, feet at LEFT, elbows and knees alternate crawling, first frame is lying still. Row 6 (bottom): six subtle standing IDLE breathing frames. These are animation frames, NOT portraits. Extremely strict even six by six grid and complete uncropped characters. Preserve character equipment but hands empty.
